_comment: One record per supervision note (पर्यवेक्षण टिप्पणी). All text is Unicode Devanagari after Kruti Dev conversion. Sections absent from a note are null.

record.doc_id: string — stable hash of file content
record.issuing_office: string — e.g. अनुमंडल पुलिस पदाधिकारी, बाघमारा

input_sections.fir: प्राथमिकी — who complained, against whom, the allegation
input_sections.place: घटनास्थल — description and boundaries of the scene
witnesses: साक्षी — one entry per witness statement

output_sections.conclusion: निष्कर्ष — case summary and finding (true / false / under which sections, against whom)
output_sections.lapses: त्रुटि — lapses by the investigating officer
directions: निर्देश — one entry per direction to the investigating officer

footer.accused_summary: अभियुक्त विवरणी — counts: FIR-named, arrested, absconding, bail

record.linked_report_2: doc_id of the SP-office Report-2 for the same case, or null

messages.content: आप एक पर्यवेक्षण पदाधिकारी हैं। दिए गए कांड विवरण के आधार पर निष्कर्ष, त्रुटि एवं अनुसंधानकर्ता को निर्देश लिखें।
<case line + header fields + input_sections, each under its Hindi heading, in document order>
